profile: strict DXF output UCSBASE and PUCSBASE name-to-table target closure

implementation.gate: fileExport preflight when requireResolvedOwners is true or readCompletenessPolicy is RequireComplete
behavior: Both standard HEADER variables must resolve to a unique emitted UCS table record when nonempty.
ASCII symbol names compare case-insensitively; byte-identical valid UTF-8 names are admitted.
Blank values and the built-in ASCII WORLD name do not require a serialized UCS table row.
Ambiguous names, malformed values, customVars shadow copies, and non-ASCII case variants without native collation evidence fail closed before destination publication.
implementation.limits: This closes strict name-target preflight only. It does not establish native orthographic UCS restoration or Unicode case-collation behavior.

authoritative_references.title: Autodesk UCSBASE system variable
authoritative_references.supports: UCSBASE is the name of the UCS used for orthographic settings; the initial value is blank and valid values include named UCS records.

authoritative_references.title: Autodesk PUCSBASE system variable
authoritative_references.supports: PUCSBASE identifies the paper-space orthographic UCS base and has a blank initial value.

authoritative_references.title: Autodesk UCS DXF reference
authoritative_references.supports: UCS symbol-table group 2 carries the UCS name; absent orthographic base handles default to WORLD.

authoritative_references.title: Autodesk ObjectARX compareSymbolName reference
authoritative_references.supports: Symbol names are compared case-insensitively. It does not specify the exact Unicode collation used by every native consumer.

authoritative_references.title: Autodesk UCS dialog reference
authoritative_references.supports: WORLD is always present as a built-in UCS and cannot be renamed or deleted.
